prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Pet Path", "body": "Choose between ready companion pets or create your own custom pet from photos."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Later In Journey Reorder: Reorder the onboarding flow so sign-in occurs after pet adoption certificate confirmation, right before generation waiting.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

   config: {"new_path_intro": {"headline": "Choose How You Want to Adopt", "body": "Pick an instant companion pet or design a unique custom pet from your own photos.", "layout": "card", "button_label": "Explore Paths"}, "_order": ["story", "new_path_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to a checklist layout detailing account cloud sync, pet recovery protection, and multi-device access.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Sync & Protect Your Pet", "body": "Sign in to save your pet companion to the cloud and restore it anytime on any device."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in with your primary email restores your previously adopted pets instantly."}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Adopt Ready Companion or Create Custom Pet", "body": "Select a ready-to-play companion for immediate launch, or upload photos to generate a unique desktop pet."}}
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Grid Layout: Change the layout of pick_friend screen to a structured two-column layout with clear companion pet previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Select the companion pet that best matches your desk style."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Notification Visual: Update the waiting screen to include a progress component and notification hint to inform users when desktop docking is complete.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Your pet is preparing for your desktop. You will be notified as soon as it is ready to dock."}}
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Checklist Stage Redesign: Redesign home_intro with a checklist layout outlining key controls (drag, hide, interact) for the new desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "body": "Use the tray menu or click your pet to interact, hide, or open companion controls."}}
9: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Spotlight Layout: Update adoption_certificate screen layout to spotlight view highlighting official pet companion adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion pet is officially adopted and ready for setup."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of choose path screen preserving both path options.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed and preserves all steps.
Adding a new introductory preview screen within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning sign-in layout preserves its core functionality and compliance rules.
Adding account recovery hint to sign-in screen is compliant with onboarding rules.
Copy update clearly presents both adoption options without violating pricing or fair design rules.
Two-column grid layout redesign preserves the core job of choosing a friend pet.
Updating waiting screen with progress indicator and notification hint is permitted inside onboarding.
Redesigning home_intro overlay with a checklist layout is allowed within onboarding.
Spotlight layout redesign of adoption certificate retains official adoption presentation.
